caveats: Network: StepFun HTTP api.stepfun.com; StepFun WS api.stepfun.com; MiniMax TTS api.minimaxi.com. Failures after 1+2 retries are recorded as rows, not retried further.
Method A upstream streams SSE deltas (15/15 successful trials). The product proxy currently buffers the full SSE before returning text.

Method B uses the dedicated realtime ASR socket `wss://api.stepfun.com/v1/realtime/asr/stream` (model stepaudio-2.5-asr-stream). Client VAD is off; key-up is `input_audio_buffer.commit`. If that socket returns 402, the conversation realtime API is probed as a workaround.

This StepFun key is on Token Plan HTTP ASR (method A works) but WebSocket realtime returned HTTP 402. Conversation realtime (wss://api.stepfun.com/v1/realtime?model=step-audio-2-mini) also 402. Method B did not stream audio.

Apple Speech status is notDetermined (supportsOnDeviceRecognition=true). This CLI skips requestAuthorization because that TCC-crashes when Cursor is the responsible process. Recorded as permission not granted. Run the binary from Terminal.app to grant Speech Recognition if you want C numbers.
CER strips Unicode punctuation/symbols/whitespace then lowercases; English product names are compared as letters.
TTS durations are whatever MiniMax produced at speed=1; they are close to the 2/4/8/12/15 s targets but not exact.
recommendation: C Apple: rejected by owner on quality (人评). H does not keep E's CER after the window slides (clips longer than W). Cost below is billed audio per 10 s of speech on clips ≥8 s. H4: final 259 ms, long CER 0.636, ~46 s billed / 10 s speech. H6: final 302 ms, long CER 1.060, ~65 s billed / 10 s speech. E: final 387 ms, CER 0.000, ~120 s billed / 10 s (grows with n²). HD (H6 hold + D on key-up): on long clips always showed D (H/D pair CER>0.05). final 538 ms, CER 0.000, ~75 s billed / 10 s. Product: H4 is the cheaper W (~46 s billed / 10 s) but only as a live preview; key-up still needs D. Accurate live text is still E. Do not ship H as the final.

apple_retry.recommendation: C Apple: rejected by owner on quality (人评). Historical numbers only. Apple on-device meets final ≤300 ms after end (median 37–190 ms) but not text-while-speaking: first_partial ≈ clip length, so the first token arrives at key-up, not mid-hold. Median CER 0.091 vs StepFun ~0; s01 is 0.545 on the fast 1.8 s clip. Server-assisted matches on-device latency and almost the same text. Use Apple as the instant post-keyup draft; replace with StepFun HTTP for accuracy. 奕枢.app Info.plist has NSMicrophoneUsageDescription but not NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription — add it before shipping Apple Speech.

Cost below is billed audio per 10 s of speech on clips ≥8 s. H4: final 259 ms, long CER 0.636, ~46 s billed / 10 s speech. H6: final 302 ms, long CER 1.060, ~65 s billed / 10 s speech. E: final 387 ms, CER 0.000, ~120 s billed / 10 s (grows with n²). HD (H6 hold + D on key-up): on long clips always showed D (H/D pair CER>0.05). final 538 ms, CER 0.000, ~75 s billed / 10 s. Product: H4 is the cheaper W (~46 s billed / 10 s) but only as a live preview; key-up still needs D. Accurate live text is still E. Do not ship H as the final.
